technical.summary: ABT shows long-term trend structure (EMA/SMA 50/200 bullish) and ADX confirmation, but lacks near-term momentum with price below all key moving averages, negative MACD/CMF, and oversold oscillators without bullish reversal signals—insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ABT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 51 days present elevated risk with no offsetting smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity from junior member with no clear directional bias; broad market sentiment neutral with no contrarian opportunity or warning signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (93) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational earnings, and earnings event in 51 days adds binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term trend structure (EMA/SMA 50/200 bullish, ADX trending) provides directional framework, and price near support (97.84) offers defined risk entry if oversold oscillators trigger reversal.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 93, strong dollar), zero fundamental support (no insider/institutional conviction), negative near-term momentum (MACD/CMF/RSI all weak), and binary earnings risk in 51 days make this a high-risk, low-probability swing entry.
